description: A modification for 12 gauge break-action shotguns. When the breach is opened, it automatically pushes a new shell into place, turning a single barrel from 1 round, to 5+1+1.
A modification for 8 gauge break-action shotguns. When the breach is opened, it automatically pushes a new shell into place, turning a single barrel from 1 round, to 3+1+1.
